|rad2txchains = 2 |rad2rxchains = 3 |rad2sstreams = 2 |rad2oui = |rad2_ant_conn = non-removable (fixed) |rad2stand = IEEE 802.11a/n/ac/ax |axqam2 = 2402 |rad2ax = 1201 |acqam2 = |rad2ac = 867 |rad2n = 300 |rad2a = 54 |rad2freq = 5 }}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== The Xiaomi AX3000T router supports 2x 802.11ax streams on both 2.4GHz :@40MHz and 5GHz @160MHz for a combined 3000Mbps wireless speed. It is based on the [[MediaTek]] MT7981 SoC. There are two versions of the Xiaomi AX3000T router: *model RD03: Chinese version *model RD23: International (Global) version Both versions have exactly the same hardware, and the only difference :is the version of the stock firmware (which is region-locked). {{See also|List of Xiaomi Wireless Devices}} ==Links of Interest== *[https://www.acwifi.net/25394.html ''Xiaomi AX3000T (RD03)'' on '''AC|WiFi'''] *[https://www.acwifi.net/29584.html ''Xiaomi AX3000E (RN07)'' on '''AC|WiFi'''] *[https://www.acwifi.net/29524.html ''Xiaomi BE3600 Pro (RN01)'' on '''AC|WiFi'''] *[https://www.acwifi.net/23700.html ''Xiaomi WR30U (MB05)'' on '''AC|WiFi'''] ===Models=== :;[[Xiaomi]] • [[List of Xiaomi Wireless Devices]] *[[Xiaomi BE3600 Pro]] (RN01) • [[Qualcomm]] IPQ5312/QCN6402 *[[Xiaomi AX3000E]] (RN07) • [[Qualcomm]] IPQ5018/QCN6102 *[[Xiaomi AX3000T]] (RD03) • [[MediaTek]] MT7981BA/MT7976CN :Xiaomi Router AX3000T (CN) • (RD03) (DVB4382CN) :Xiaomi Router AX3000T (INT) • (RD23) (EU, Global) *Xiaomi Mesh System AX3000 NE (RD28) • (WR30U/M/T) *Xiaomi Whole-Room Router AX3000 (RD01) :Xiaomi Whole-Home Router AX3000 (RD02) • [[Qualcomm]] IPQ5018 ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{ombox | type = speedy | image = | style = | textstyle = color: red; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic; | text = '''Warning!''' Don't brick your router! Some AX3000T devices come with a new NAND flash chip: Winbond 25n01kvzeir. :This chip is incompatible with the official stable OpenWrt 23.05.4 image :and uboot! Don´t try to flash it without checking your chip! However SNAPSHOT build is fully compatible and tested with both flash chips since Aug.13: *https://github.com/openwrt/openwrt/commit/81481c805aa56f6452d7e7577d42eb6b89a6869d New 1.0.84 firmware has been set, the delivered routers have got the firmware already. :There is no possibility to install OpenWrt on RD03, see link: *https://forum.openwrt.org/t/openwrt-support-for-xiaomi-ax3000t/180490/1143? }} {{ombox | type = notice | image = | style = | textstyle = | text = Both the International (RD23) and Chinese (RD03) versions of the router are
supported, but OpenWrt installation is much simpler on the Chinese version. }} {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/xiaomi/xiaomi_mi_router_ax3000t |wikipage = https://openwrt.org/inbox/toh/xiaomi/ax3000t |forumpage = https://forum.openwrt.org/t/openwrt-support-for-xiaomi-ax3000t/180490 |forumpage2 = |forumpage3 = |github = |target = mediatek |subtarget = filogic |arch = aarch64_cortex-a53 |support_started_version = 23.05.4 |current_supported_version = |last_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = |comment = }} Please insert instructions here [[Category:English Documentation]]
